paper.title_en: Nucleon-sigma terms at $m_\pi=222 ~\rm MeV$ with a variational analysis from lattice QCD
paper.abstract_en: Nucleon sigma terms are important for the decomposition of the nucleon mass and for searches for new physics beyond the Standard Model involving scalar interactions. A persistent tension between lattice QCD and phenomenological determinations may be due to uncontrolled excited-state contamination in lattice QCD analyses. In previous work at $m_π=429~\rm MeV$, we showed that this contamination is dominated by $Nσ$ states and can be strongly suppressed with a variational analysis using $N$ and $Nσ$ operators. In this talk, we present preliminary results at $m_π=222~\rm MeV$, where the $σ$ becomes unstable and decays into $ππ$. We investigate whether the same small variational basis can remove the expected $Nππ$ contamination through the overlap of the $Nσ$ operator with these states.
